eligibility.rule: A page carrying superseded_by is ineligible, as api.find treats it.

a.definition: health_lint._candidate_pairs: two eligible pages are a candidate when they share at least one cited sources[].path, or one page links directly to the other.

a-path.definition: Signal (a)'s shared-path part on its own: two eligible pages citing at least one common sources[].path.
a-path.verdict: its own verdict and counts, free of annotation links by construction

b.definition: Jaccard similarity of wiki_state._tokenise(title + ' ' + the first paragraph of ## Decision) between the two eligible pages; for a background page without ## Decision, its title and its first body paragraph.

c.definition: Shared entity mentions counted as missing-cross-link counts them: the entity vocabulary is every fixture page's slug except index, log and overview; mentions are found with health_lint._entity_mentions over the body after the frontmatter, with the per-file glossary aliases prose_lint.load_avoid_map gives; the intersection less the two pages' own slugs.

annotation_linked.definition: A true candidate is marked annotation_linked when the only part of its signal that fired is a link FR-006 wrote from an annotation (a callout, a Consequences link, the incident link), or when findings already reports the pair as open-conflict.
annotation_linked.why: FR-006 writes intra-wiki links exactly for corpus-annotated pairs, the same source as the labels, so a link-only hit is not evidence of detection. Signal (c) is unaffected: it subtracts the two pages' own slugs. Signal (b) reads titles and the Y-statement paragraph, which the annotation links never touch.

scope.pattern_pattern: every unordered pair of the 14 pattern pages (91 pairs)
scope.secondary: the 91-pair table is reported as secondary

labels.background_rule: A pair involving a background page is false unless it is listed in labels.json background_pairs with a true disposition.

pass_bar.rule: A signal passes when it finds every eligible pair labelled redundant or conflicting and its false candidates do not outnumber its true ones across the whole scope.
pass_bar.meaning: A pass is grounds to draft an issue for a findings kind, not evidence that such a kind would work in general.

retrieval.method: api.find(question, paths, max_pages=5, ranker=r) for each question in questions.json and each r in discovery.RANKERS
retrieval.hit_at_1: The top page is a gold page; the config-redaction question's gold includes its trap page, so a top-ranked trap is a hit at 1 there.
retrieval.hit_at_5: Every gold page is among the five.
retrieval.trap_outranks: The trap page ranks above the reuse_target, or the target is absent while the trap is present; null for a question with no trap.
retrieval.superseded: For a question with a superseded page, that page (linked from index.md) must be listed ineligible with reason superseded and never selected.
